data.title: Agility Robotics co-founder on its Nasdaq debut, lessons from Amazon, and the future of work
data.description: Agility Robotics, which makes the Digit humanoid robot for warehouses and factories, began trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday after a $2.5 billion SPAC merger. Co-founder Jonathan Hurst described how Amazon's warehouse tests convinced the company it needed a robot that could work safely next to people.
data.author: Todd Bishop
